identity.name: War Council Seal
identity.summary: A wax red seal held in a scalloped iron frame.
identity.description: Adds 2 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Each orthogonally touching weapon gains +3 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
identity.lore: The signature was erased; the promise was kept.

effects.description: Adds 2 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Each orthogonally touching weapon gains +3 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Cadence Spurs, Captain's Baton, Roseglass Brooch into War Council Seal.

visual.brief: A wax red seal held in a scalloped iron frame.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
